_comment: Two-pass ('hires fix') graph for 3GB-class cards. Pass 1 renders the verified %latent_width%x%latent_height% latent; pass 2 upscales the latent to %hires_width%x%hires_height% and re-samples it at 0.45 denoise, which adds real detail instead of the softness of a plain resize. It never decodes at the requested %width%x%height%: the final resize to the video size stays a CPU Lanczos step outside the graph. scripts/generation.py chooses it automatically for cards between COMFYUI_HIRES_MIN_VRAM_MB and COMFYUI_UPSCALE_MIN_VRAM_MB, and falls back to comfyui_workflow_lowvram_tiny.json for the same request if this card reports running out of memory. COMFYUI_HIRES=0 disables it.
